newsitem.title: USA: Valley Forge, BEI in pact.
newsitem.headline: Valley Forge, BEI in pact.

text.p: Valley Forge Scientific Corp said Wednesday that it signed an exclusive, five-year worldwide distribution agreement for the BEI Medical Systems subsidiary of BEI Electronics Inc to distribute a newly developed Valley Forge electrosurgical system.
Valley Forge said the proprietary system is for cutting, coagulating and ablating tissue during gynecological and laparascopic abdominal surgery and offers an alternative to hysterectomies.
The company said the agreement between it and BEI is the first in what is expected to be a series of strategic alliances of the two companies in gynecology and other specialty surgical disciplines.
